trello.name: Renew and deploy SSL and internal CA certificates
trello.desc: Owner: Ben. Deadline: August 22nd. Renew the wildcard SSL cert for api.ourapp.com (expires September 1st) and deploy it to the load balancers. Also rotate the internal CA cert that signs the service mesh, which expires two weeks after the public cert. Both certs should be handled in the same change window. Set up cert-manager for both certificates so they auto-renew going forward, eliminating the need for annual manual renewals.

trello.name: Implement PDF export for reports
trello.desc: Owner: Aisha. Deadline: end of month. Deliverable is one task with two halves: (1) Backend renders the report to PDF using headless Chrome; (2) Frontend adds the export button and a progress state to handle large reports that take a few seconds. Aisha will complete both halves herself. As part of finishing the feature, record a short demo GIF for marketing to use in the changelog. Acceptance criteria: working PDF export with UI button, progress indication for large reports, and a demo GIF delivered.

trello.name: Restore staging parity with production
trello.desc: Owner: Ben. Two parts: (1) Write a nightly job that diffs the staging database schema against production and posts to the infra channel if they diverge; (2) Run the three pending migrations on staging today to bring it back in sync with production. Acceptance criteria: staging is no longer behind production, and the nightly diff job is deployed and reporting to the infra channel.
